gloss: oily skin; oily constitution; greasy complexion

definitions.gloss: oily skin; oily constitution; greasy complexion
definitions.explanation: A skin type characterized by excessive sebum (oil) production, resulting in a shiny or greasy appearance. Used in skincare and cosmetics contexts.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{脂性|あぶらしょう}なのでテカりやすい。
examples.english: I have oily skin, so my face gets shiny easily.

examples.japanese: {脂性|あぶらしょう}{肌|はだ}には{油分|ゆぶん}の{少|すく}ない{化粧品|けしょうひん}がいい。
examples.english: Cosmetics with less oil are good for oily skin.

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}になると{脂性|あぶらしょう}がひどくなって、{洗顔|せんがん}の{回数|かいすう}が{増|ふ}える。
examples.english: When summer comes, my oily skin gets worse and I wash my face more often.

notes:
A compound of {脂|あぶら} (oil, grease) and {性|しょう} (nature, constitution). Describes a skin type or constitutional tendency toward excess oil production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}{肌|はだ}: oily skin
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}{用|よう}: for oily skin
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}のケア: skincare for oily skin
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}を{改善|かいぜん}する: to improve oily skin

SKIN TYPES IN JAPANESE:
- {脂性|あぶらしょう}{肌|はだ} / オイリー{肌|はだ}: oily skin
- {乾燥|かんそう}{肌|はだ}: dry skin
- {混合|こんごう}{肌|はだ}: combination skin
- {敏感|びんかん}{肌|はだ}: sensitive skin
- {普通|ふつう}{肌|はだ}: normal skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- オイリー{肌|はだ}: oily skin — the English loanword equivalent; more commonly used in cosmetics marketing and younger speech
- {脂|あぶら}ぎった: greasy, oily — an adjective that can describe skin, hair, or food; more vivid and slightly negative

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as {脂性|あぶらせい} in some contexts, though {脂性|あぶらしょう} is the more common reading.
